steps.title: Establish the passive reference fixture
steps.explanation: At zero pose and activation, the authored strip begins at its reference shape. The orange surface is the same-pose artistic skin baseline; the teal body uses the existing edge/volume energy.
steps.observe: Upper span is 180 mm, mean J=1 and sampled penetration is zero. The maximum free force satisfies the unchanged 2e-5 N per-coordinate stopping criterion.

steps.title: Isolate shape activation from bone motion
steps.explanation: Keep the pose fixed and set shape activation to 0.6. Preferred shortening drives the volume network; it is a separate one-way shape law and adds no extra moment to the hinge.
steps.observe: Upper span shortens to about 170.768 mm while mean J is about 0.999324. This fixture converges locally, but its minimum J near 0.954272 shows that mean volume does not describe every cell.

steps.title: Inspect a difficult compressed pose
steps.explanation: Prescribe 90 degrees with the same activation and cap the solve at 80 iterations. This compresses the strip near the sampled capsule contact and compares it with the same-pose artistic baseline.
steps.observe: The maximum free force is about 2.65 N, far above criterion, so Converged is false. Sampled penetration is about 5.89 mm and minimum J about 0.642; baseline minimum J is about 0.171.

steps.title: Increase the budget without hiding failure
steps.explanation: Keep the model and prescribed state fixed, increasing only the cap to 320. Observe what improves and what still prevents accepting the shape as an equilibrated result.
steps.observe: Penetration falls to about 0.457 mm, but maximum free force remains about 0.444 N and Converged stays false. Toggle sampled contact manually to inspect its effect; neither setting guarantees intersection-free surfaces.

audit.finding: An angle-only adapter concealed activation and solver budget, and displayed an approximate iterate without the actual stopping threshold or baseline volume loss.
audit.change: Expose fixed-pose activation, iteration budget and contact, with true maximum-force criterion, local/mean J, span and penetration diagnostics.
audit.remaining: Authored edge/volume network, not FEM or anatomy. One-way prescribed pose/activation, sampled compliant contact, no skin self-contact or surface-intersection guarantee; compressed fixture remains unconverged.
